recipes.title: Theme-respecting table

provenance.note: Independently written from documented Openplanet UI APIs; no palette or external source copied.

recipes.expected: A two-column table inherits active theme colors and spacing; changing Openplanet themes changes its chrome.

recipes.title: Stable widget identities
recipes.expected: Changing the visible label preserves the same explicit widget identity; repeated controls remain distinct and report stable IDs.

recipes.title: Overlay-aware render owner
recipes.expected: Frame 0 shows RenderInterface drawing while Render skips; frame 120 shows the reverse. Both report one shared-window submission and PASS: one copy.

recipes.title: Visibility-safe semantic action
recipes.expected: A hidden component rejects the default semantic action without mutation and reports a concise retry/force next step; forced invocation is labeled forced.

recipes.title: Balanced NVG scissor

provenance.note: Tiny independent API exercise; deliberately not copied from any plugin helper family.

recipes.expected: A cyan circle is clipped to a fixed rectangle and a white outline reveals the expected clip boundary.

recipes.title: Clipped draw-list gradient

provenance.note: Independently written API demonstration using a generated four-corner gradient.

recipes.expected: A fixed-size four-corner gradient stays inside its clip rectangle; clip depth returns to zero.

recipes.title: Deterministic pulse state

provenance.note: Independent minimal state model; capture phase is controlled by gallery frame, not wall-clock time.

recipes.expected: The progress bar and reported phase exactly match capture frames 0, 30, 60, 90, and 120.

recipes.title: Kinetic spectrum reactor

provenance.note: New composition inspired by the documented tm-agent animated-border and pulsing-wave concepts; no unresolved-license source or palette copied.

recipes.expected: A cyan-violet-amber containment field travels around the panel perimeter and feeds four synchronized conduits into a recessed breathing reactor, with orbital spark trails and radial energy ticks; frame 120 closes the loop by matching frame 0.

recipes.title: Spectral relay typography

provenance.note: Independently reimagines tm-agent's counter-propagating text-wave idea as a Trackmania checkpoint relay; no source, palette, or assets copied.

recipes.expected: Two counter-propagating spectral signals race through a monumental CHECKPOINT RELAY wordmark while lane traces, phase markers, and an interference bloom reveal the deterministic collision point; the composition remains legible and dramatic in every frozen frame.

recipes.title: Split monument

provenance.note: Independently authored from the high-level thesis of measured race-result hierarchy found across local Openplanet HUDs; no source, palette, branding, fonts, data, or assets copied.

recipes.expected: An asymmetrical limestone result plate balances a monumental clipped 01 against a precision split ledger; sector emphasis travels through the ledger while a measured NEW BEST lozenge interrupts the baseline rule without disturbing the static hero composition.

recipes.title: Apex envelope

provenance.note: Conceptual normalized-range research only; independently authored geometry, dimensions, palette, text, and motion with no source or assets copied.

recipes.expected: A restrained carbon instrument horizon maps steering load into a narrowing teal safety envelope; an ivory marker crosses the threshold into a burnt-sienna overslip wedge while compact SIDE, TARGET, and MARGIN readouts preserve calibrated hierarchy.

recipes.title: Strategy switchboard

provenance.note: Independently reimagines the interactive-distribution and decision-matrix theses from the source inventory as a Trackmania pit-strategy control; no source, palette, or assets copied.

recipes.expected: A slate pit-wall decision matrix carries four route cells around a physical toggle rail; the weighted lever and measured directive plate travel PUSH, BALANCED, CONSERVE, OVERTAKE as the frame story advances, closing the loop at frame 120.

recipes.title: Trajectory orrery

provenance.note: Clean-room pseudo-3D projection inspired only by the depth-aware gizmo thesis in the source inventory; gallery-owned projection math, palette, and composition with nothing copied.

recipes.expected: A void-dark orbital instrument projects five tilted rings around a warm primary; each ring splits into a dim far stroke, a dashed guide, and a bright doubled near stroke while bodies grow, brighten, and trail as they cross the near rim, closing the loop at frame 120.

recipes.title: Altitude ledger

provenance.note: Independently reimagines the altitude-ladder thesis from the source inventory as a Trackmania hill climb; gallery-owned data, palette, and label collision model with nothing copied.

recipes.expected: A parchment hill-climb ledger reduces six climbers to one elevation axis: the hero diamond and rival rings rise and shuffle while collision-managed rank rows keep every tag legible, falling riders earn a down tick, and the loop closes at frame 120.

recipes.title: Ghost delta cartogram

provenance.note: Independently reimagines the route-heatmap and trajectory theses from the source inventory as a signed delta field; gallery-owned route, field, and palette with nothing copied.

recipes.expected: A deep-sea route ring carries a signed gain/loss field whose segments widen and glow green or sienna with magnitude; six sector gates report state, a ghost marker trails the pulsing live tracer by nine points, and a measured plate reads the average delta.

recipes.title: Midnight switchyard

provenance.note: Independently reimagines the node-graph propagation thesis from the source inventory as a Trackmania freight yard; gallery-owned graph, timing, and palette with nothing copied.

recipes.expected: A midnight rail-yard diagram propagates an amber signal wave from the throat through a branching graph; switch blades physically swing as blocks energize, sidings glow with lantern halos, and the terminus lantern reports ARRIVED before the loop closes at frame 120.

recipes.title: Weatherline observatory

provenance.note: Independently reimagines the procedural-contour thesis from the source inventory as a weather chart; gallery-owned field, levels, and front geometry with nothing copied.

recipes.expected: A parchment synoptic chart renders a procedural pressure field as marching-squares isobars with a bold primary line, sweeping warm and cold fronts with disc and tooth conventions, and a corner station model; the whole field drifts and closes its loop at frame 120.

recipes.title: Chicane typesetter

provenance.note: Independently reimagines the measured-typographic-motion thesis from the source inventory as type riding a racing line; gallery-owned line, wordmark, and palette with nothing copied.

recipes.expected: A wordmark surfs a painted racing line: each glyph is placed at its own arc offset with a tangent direction tick, alternating red/white kerb blocks flank the dashed center paint, and measured APEX flags mark the tightest kerbs as the text mass loops home at frame 120.

recipes.title: Slipstream loom

provenance.note: Independently reimagines the layered-ribbon thesis from the source inventory as an interlaced slipstream weave; gallery-owned strands, weave order, and palette with nothing copied.

recipes.expected: Four draft-trail ribbons braid through faint warp guides: every segment is drawn back-to-front from a physically consistent weave order so crossings interlace, three-stroke bodies carry shadow, body, and spine, and crossing knots mark each change of the front ribbon as the weave slides home at frame 120.
